limitations: État actif non capturé en PNG de production pour ME2 et ME3 : le relevé DOM immédiat voit le statut dans les deux cas, mais la fenêtre naturelle de trois secondes expire avant Pause. Aucun des neuf PNG n’est présenté comme capture positive de cet état actif.

The active +15% states were actually captured and individually reviewed in DEV03. The real 1.15 damage multiplier, pause and expiration are native-test findings; this production run verifies the visible description, displacement, contact and ended status without forcing time.
Desktop screenshots use the declared native 1280 x 1900 viewport. Mobile 390 x 844 evidence is limited to arena layout and horizontal fit.

This is a bounded two-dimensional ATB arena. No original map, obstacle collision solver, physical swept path, sprite movement in a 3D scene, full campaign, original ranks or artistic fidelity is certified. Other powers retain their documented abstract ranges.
result: All original captures have an explicit SHA-matched actual-opening attestation in the linked original review.
